title: Honua Open-Data Source Catalog
description: Curated registry of open geospatial data sources that the area-import provisioner can fetch, clip to an area, and load into Honua Server. Catalog is config-as-data: adding a source is a data edit, not a code change.

catalogVersion.description: Semver of the catalog document format.

updated.description: ISO date the catalog was last curated.

id.description: Stable machine id, kebab-case. Used as the --source argument to the provisioner.

spdx.description: SPDX id where one exists, else a short label (e.g. 'US-PD', 'ODbL-1.0').

attributionText.description: Verbatim attribution string to surface on derived layers when attributionRequired is true.

status.description: 'available' = a working extract recipe exists; 'placeholder' = curated but extraction is a future slice (TODO).

extractMethod.description: How an AREA parameter selects a subset. bbox = clip by lon/lat envelope; admin-boundary = clip by a named/geocoded polygon; census-geoid = select rows whose Census GEOID prefix matches the area.

areaParam.description: Declares which AREA inputs this source accepts and how they map to the extract.

products.description: The layer(s) this source yields. Each product becomes one Honua layer after import.

product.description: Machine id of the product within the source (e.g. 'roads', 'buildings', 'county-boundaries'). Used as --product.

format.description: Source-side format of the fetched file (one of Honua's 13 import formats, or an intermediate that the recipe converts).

sourceProduct.description: What downstream artifact this product is built into. 'features' = vector layer (this slice). 'geocoder'/'router' = future GP-Batch products (see docs/guides/open-data-provisioner.md).

fetch.description: Declarative fetch recipe. urlTemplate placeholders are substituted from the AREA param.

sampleUrl.description: A concrete small example URL for docs/testing (NOT committed as data).

clip.description: Whether the fetched file still needs clipping to the AREA after download (e.g. a statewide file clipped to a bbox). false when the URL already returns exactly the area.

tile.description: Optional PMTiles generation hints once the layer is published.
